_about: High-demand things that announce ticket sales by press release rather than by feed. Each build reads the page and records what it says now; a change of status is news for the digest and the app. Add entries by hand; never guess a date — leave `expected` as a plain note or empty.

items.title: Newport Folk Festival 2027
items.expected: Sells out within minutes of going on sale; the on-sale is announced on the site and by email first.

items.title: Newport Jazz Festival 2027
items.expected: Sells fast; announced on the site and by email.

items.title: PPAC Broadway series — new shows & single tickets
items.expected: Single tickets for each Broadway title go on sale a few weeks before the run; the page's on-sale dates feed the app automatically.

items.title: WaterFire 2027 lighting schedule
items.expected: Free; the season schedule is usually posted in spring.

items.title: Rhode Island Breakers (UFL) — 2027 schedule & tickets
items.expected: New UFL team for 2027 (head coach named Nov 2026). The league schedule is usually posted early in the year; home games will be added to the app from ESPN's UFL feed the moment the team appears there.

items.title: Boston Legacy FC (NWSL) at Centreville Bank Stadium — 2027
items.expected: The stadium announced Legacy FC's 2027 home venue; home games come from ESPN's NWSL feed once the schedule is posted.

items.title: Rhode Island Lights Festival at Centreville Bank Stadium
items.expected: First-ever, announced by the stadium; dates and tickets on that page.
